task.instruction: Recommend a monitoring intervention. Treat the supplied records as the complete synthetic evidence set and make one selection for each declared decision.
task.deliverable: A recommendation that identifies scope, first placement, and supporting evidence. Cite the named evidence references and do not list mutually incompatible selections.

evidence.content: The facility sketch shows a shared airflow path, while the access rule says the storage aisle must remain unobstructed.
A synthetic reading room has a warm corner near a return vent and a cool storage aisle; only one portable monitor can be moved.
This synthetic recommend record for case-research-a11 is bounded to the named observation and constraint. A valid conclusion must distinguish them, cite both, and avoid an unstated factual claim.

A.content: Prefer a bounded intervention at the immediate decision point when wider changes are not required by the evidence.

B.content: Prefer an intervention that accounts for connected incentives and downstream effects when the evidence shows they matter.

irrelevant.content: Keep the artifact title concise enough to fit on one line.

decisions.prompt: Choose exactly one recommend judgment for case-research-a11; justify it from the observation and constraint records rather than listing alternatives.
